title: podman-wslkerninst: use filepath.Base for the log message prefix
body:
path.Base only recognizes a forward slash as a separator. This binary is built for Windows only, where os.Args[0] is conventionally a backslash-separated absolute path, so path.Base finds no separator and returns the whole string instead of the file name.

That value is passed to setupLogging, which hands it to the logrus formatter in event-hook.go, where it becomes the prefix on every log line. The event log source itself is hardcoded to ".NET Runtime", so the visible effect is that each entry's message body carries the full executable path in place of the binary name.

Use filepath.Base, which recognizes the platform separator.

Related to: #25165

Scoped deliberately to the one Windows-only binary in the tree using `path` on a host path. The other `path` uses I checked split two ways: genuinely slash-separated inputs (container-internal, guest and URL paths: see the existing comments at `pkg/specgenutil/volumes.go:818` and `pkg/machine/ignition/ignition.go:172`), and host paths sitting behind linux/freebsd build constraints or in the Linux-only systemd generator. The closest sibling is `cmd/quadlet/main.go:444`, which uses the same `path.Base(os.Args[0])` idiom with no build constraint. Quadlet only runs as a Linux systemd generator so it isn't a live bug, but I'm glad to take it in a follow-up if you want the sweep continued.

I used "Related to" rather than "Fixes" because #25165 reads as a tree-wide request and this addresses one instance. Lmk if you'd rather it close the issue.

Worth flagging that this binary no longer appears to be built or shipped. The WiX bundle entry that launched it went in 91e4f6918a29 ("Remove the option to install WSL/HyperV") and the build step in df4aed78a223 ("Remove providers checks from the Windows Installer"), so nothing references it by name now, though the package is still type-checked by the `GOOS=windows` wildcard lint. The code is still wrong and the issue asks for this change, but if you'd rather drop `cmd/podman-wslkerninst/` entirely, say so and I'll switch the PR over.

Checks run locally, all clean: `GOOS=windows go build ./cmd/podman-wslkerninst/`, `GOOS=windows go vet` on the same package, and `gofmt -l` on the changed file. I have not run `make validatepr`, hence the unticked box.
